method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Tommy 审判接近尾声时，Hattie 开始阅读关于连环杀手的书，且专挑冷静聚焦的传记、关注这些人作案前是什么样。
facts.anchor: Near the end of Tommy’s trial she began reading about serial killers.

facts.fact: 所谓专家们一致认可的特征包括童年受虐以及折磨和杀害动物。
facts.anchor: mainly the presence of childhood abuse, as well as the torture and killing of animals.

facts.fact: Hattie 判断 Tommy 童年没有受虐——凭直觉和她作为强制报告者受过的识别训练她会知道——也没有虐待动物的迹象。
facts.anchor: There had been no abuse—she would have known, either through her own intuition or the training she’d received to recognize the signs as a mandated reporter.

facts.fact: Hattie 看表发现他们已离开一个多小时，Kevin 和 Wendy 有充足时间打完电话，且很快要去精神病医生处赴约。
facts.anchor: when she looks at her watch she sees they’ve been gone well over an hour.

facts.fact: Hattie 走近后看见一只海鸥仰面挣扎，Julian 正把一根削尖的木棍刺穿它、把它钉在岩石上、扭动木棍深入其内脏。
facts.anchor: A seagull lies squirming on its back, its beak open and gasping silently as Julian digs a sharpened stick through its center, impaling it to the rock below.

facts.fact: Hattie 本能出手，抓住 Julian 上臂使劲把他拽起来，他轻得象充了氦气，脸上露出惊讶与恐惧。
facts.anchor: Her hand latches on to his upper arm and yanks him upward as hard as she can.

facts.fact: Hattie 再看发现海鸥其实早已死亡多时、并非被木棍刺死，羽毛间和空眼窝里有虫子爬动，而 Julian 手里的棍子又细又钝。
facts.anchor: The gull is dead and has been for some time. Who knows what killed it, but it wasn’t a stick through its center.

facts.fact: Wendy 走来问发生什么，Hattie 松手并向她解释是怕 Julian 碰死鸟；Wendy 轻轻拿走他手里的棍子扔到一边。
facts.anchor: She gently takes it from him and tosses it aside.

facts.fact: Wendy 带 Julian 回去洗手并口头向 Hattie 道谢，两人离开时 Julian 只回头看了一次，但眼里恐惧未散。
facts.anchor: Julian glances over his shoulder only once.
